4: Gemara: This is the correct version of the text: From where is it derived? (What kind of questions is) From where!? It's like we mean to say later etc. - And here is the meaning: From where is it derived that the 11th, 12th, and 13th are appropriate days for reading (the Megilah)? For (only) the 14th and 15th are written in the Bible (Megilat Esther). The Gemara retorts by asking "From where is it derived?" with astonishment.  This is not obligatory rather the Sages provided a leniency as we shall see later on.
In order that they may provide - So that they will be available on Purim to provide for the needs regarding the Purim feast to the residents of the large cities.
